result.topic_en: A German historical note, not mathematics, on Cyrus the Great: the fall of Lydia and Babylon, Croesus's defeat (540 BC), Babylon's fall (538 BC), and Cyrus's death at the hands of the Massagetae queen Tomyris, followed by a new section on Persian culture.
